title: Two GPT-5 options added to the text API
summary:
Two GPT-5 options joined the text API, alongside model-routing changes and sturdier error handling.

Added text-only `gpt5` for the nectar tier and `gpt-5-nano` for anonymous use. Both support tools; Nano also accepts image input.

Mapped `deepseek-reasoning` to DeepSeek R1 0528 on Vertex AI. `openai-large` moved from flower to seed, with its maximum input reduced from 9,000 to 5,000 characters.

The text service now catches failures while sending error responses, and the OpenAI-compatible client passes the model key to request transforms and adds error diagnostics. The chance of adding a referral link also dropped from 8% to 3%.

highlights.title: GPT-5 for text
highlights.text: Use `gpt5` for text-only requests with tool support on the nectar tier. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=gpt5).

highlights.title: GPT-5 Nano for anonymous use
highlights.text: Use `gpt-5-nano` without signing in for text or image input, with tool support. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=gpt-5-nano).
